description:
Retrieve citation relationships for a paper.

Returns either papers that cite the given paper (incoming) or papers
that the given paper cites (outgoing).

direction.description:
Citation direction — "incoming" (papers citing this one)
or "outgoing" (papers this one cites). Default "incoming".

limit.description: Maximum number of citations to return (default 20).

name: get_citations
title: Get Citations
